seoTitle: How to Collect PayPal Payments With Jotform
metaDescription: Learn how to connect PayPal to a Jotform form in 2026, authenticate your merchant account, and configure products, subscriptions, or donations.
intro: Getting paid through a form requires more than just an input field, and Jotform's native PayPal integration handles the checkout logic for you. This guide covers adding a payment field, connecting your PayPal merchant account, and setting up whether you're charging for products, subscriptions, or accepting donations.

steps.heading: Open the Payments panel
steps.body: In your form builder, click Add Form Element and open the Payments tab to see integration options.

steps.heading: Select PayPal
steps.body: Choose PayPal Business or PayPal Personal from the integration grid depending on your account type.

steps.heading: Connect your account
steps.body: Launch the Payment Settings wizard and click Connect, then authenticate your live PayPal credentials in the secure authorization window.

steps.heading: Configure payment type
steps.body: Set up the payment field for individual products, subscriptions, or user-defined donation amounts, depending on your use case.

steps.heading: Test and finalize
steps.body: Customize order summaries, tax parameters, and shipping margins, then test the payment layout in sandbox mode before going live.

faq.question: Do I need a PayPal Business account to accept payments on Jotform?
faq.answer: Both PayPal Business and PayPal Personal integration options are available, though a Business account typically offers more features for commercial use.

faq.question: Can I test payments before going live?
faq.answer: Yes, the integration includes a sandbox mode so you can verify your payment layout works correctly before accepting real transactions.

faq.question: Can I accept both one-time payments and recurring subscriptions?
faq.answer: Yes, the payment settings let you configure the field for standard products or recurring subscription billing depending on what you're offering.

faq.question: Does Jotform charge extra fees on top of PayPal's own fees?
faq.answer: Payment processing fees are set by PayPal itself, while any Jotform-specific costs depend on your account plan and payment feature access.
